lines.ruling: Ruling: scope; as in the goal-1 and landing render rulings: an entry with any code other than none, B, W or BW (code E, D, O, N, L and the rest, the 'other' choice of sales.code) is refused at sales.one by sales.bad_code ("Only applicable B and W adjustments are supported"; i8949 pp. 7-11, columns (e) through (h)), so (g) never stands for an entry that needs another code's adjustment. The code B part (signed per the worksheet) and the code W part (i8949 p. 10, code W, "enter the correct amount of the nondeductible loss as a positive number in column (g)") match, as the reviewer says; this merge's change to (g) only added boxes G and J to the code B test.
